questions.question: Compare IPv4 and IPv6 headers. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• The IPv4 header is 20 to 60 bytes long, as it has optional fields. It includes fields like
  • checksum, identification, flags, and fragment offset, which help in error-checking and
  • fragmentation of data packets.
  • The IPv6 header is fixed at 40 bytes, with no optional fields , making it more streamlined
  • and efficient. - 1 mark. [U]/ [CO 1]

questions.question: Differentiate between a primary server and a secondary server in DNS. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:

  • records, Primary Server is the "master" server for DNS data.
  • Secondary Server: Provides fault tolerance and redundancy, ensuring DNS availability even if
  • the primary server fails. - 1 mark. [U]/ [CO 2]
